Subject: POC readiness + evaluation plan — Catalyst Data

Hi Liz / Platform team —

Thanks for the productive discovery call today. Quick recap so we’re aligned and can get the POC rolling:

Summary of pain & goals
- Current pain: inference latency variability and inconsistent token costs when serving multiple prompt families.
- Primary business goal: reduce unit inference cost by 35% and guarantee p95 < 450ms for single-turn lookups at 512 tokens.
- Secondary: preserve output fidelity for ranking and extractive QA workloads.

Proposed POC scope (30 days)
- Workloads: 1) ranking reranker (batch scoring) 2) extractive QA for support KB.
- Success metrics: p95 latency target 450ms, average cost/token reduction >= 30% vs current baseline, ranking precision delta within +/-2% of current model.
- Eval plan: we’ll run your prompt_set_v1.csv (attached) through Redwood Optimize; results will include latency histograms, cost per 1k tokens, and quality regression checks against your golden set.

Technical access & prerequisites
- Required from Catalyst: S3 bucket with sample inference logs + golden eval set (read-only IAM user); IP range for VPC peering (or we can do SSH jumpbox if preferred).
- Redwood scope: provision a Dedicated instance behind a private VPC (customer-managed peering), enable prefix caching for the QA workflow, and apply quantization profile we recommend for the reranker.
- Owner roles: Catalyst ops -> provide IAM + network (Platform Ops); Catalyst data -> own golden set and validation labels (Liz). Redwood -> Sean (technical lead, infra), Evelyn -> engagement owner and product lead, Kimberly -> access + billing coordinator.

Next steps (this week)
1) Catalyst to confirm preferred connectivity option (VPC peering or temporary SSH) and share a target S3 path by Wednesday 2027-11-03.
2) Sean and Catalyst ops to set up peering and IAM user (expected 24–48 hours once info received).
3) Evelyn to share POC scope doc and DocuSign for the standard POC MSA (attached link).
4) Identify 3 representative prompts per workflow for the initial eval run.

Attachments included: poc_scope_template.pdf, prompt_set_v1.csv, redwood-access-instructions.txt

If that matches your understanding, say "go" and we’ll queue the infra. Happy to hop on a 20-min ops call tomorrow if that helps.

Cheers,
Evelyn Hart
